scope: Encyclopaedia Mundarica historical government-printing series versus modern Gyan Publishing House 16-volume manifestation

historical_evidence.source: Index Bibliographicus Societatis Iesu 1938 / ARSI-hosted bibliography
historical_evidence.observed_statement: Bibliographic entry records Encyclopaedia Mundarica Volume XI and XII under Superintendent Government Printing, Bihar, Patna, with continuous pagination 3175-3456 and 3457-3707.
historical_evidence.evidence_role: contemporaneous bibliographic corroboration for historical government-printing volume numbering and pagination

historical_evidence.source: Google Books bibliographic record derived from New York Public Library copy
historical_evidence.observed_statement: Catalogues Encyclopaedia Mundarica, Volume 13, Johann Hoffmann and Arthur van Emelen, Superintendent government printing, Bihar and Orissa; record digitized from a New York Public Library original.
historical_evidence.evidence_role: independent library-derived manifestation signal for historical Volume XIII

historical_evidence.observed_statement: Bibliography describes Encyclopaedia Mundarica as 13 volumes, with I-XI in 1930-1937 and XII-XIII in 1950, and identifies a St. Albert's Theological College Library holding.
historical_evidence.evidence_role: secondary corroboration and acquisition lead only; not authoritative proof of exact publication chronology or holding completeness

modern_manifestation_evidence.observed_statement: Gyan Publishing House, 2009 record is explicitly titled Encyclopaedia Mundarica: In 16 Volumes, with a separately numbered Volume 13 manifestation.
Lists a 2009 Gyan Publishing House Vol.16th manifestation with ISBN 9788121203227.
modern_manifestation_evidence.evidence_role: commercial corroboration of modern numbered Volume XVI only

reconciliation.historical_text_volume_model_supported: At least I-XIII is independently supported; multiple sources describe a 13-volume historical text series.
reconciliation.separate_plate_fascicle_status: Historical Volume I preface/OCR discovery mentions plates gathered into a separate fascicle, but authoritative complete plate-fascicle scan/page accounting remains unresolved and is not promoted here.
reconciliation.recommended_data_model: Preserve the release's 16 numbered acquisition slots for modern manifestation tracking, but distinguish historical work/manifestation evidence: I-XIII historical text volumes are the defensible supported sequence; XIV-XVI must not be described as historical text volumes unless primary bibliographic or physical evidence proves that relationship.
reconciliation.deduplication_rule: Do not collapse modern Gyan numbered volumes XIV-XVI into historical government-printing identities solely by matching series title or numbering. Work-level and manifestation-level records must remain separate until edition mapping is proven.
